title: US and Nine Countries Sign San Francisco Declaration on AI Supply Chain
summary: The United States, Australia, India, Israel, Japan, South Korea, Qatar, Singapore, the UAE and the UK signed the San Francisco Declaration on November 15, affirming that economic security is the foundation of national security and pledging joint protection of sensitive technologies and critical infrastructure in the superintelligence \(SI\) supply chain. The declaration sets up five working groups covering innovation policy frameworks, SI applications in critical sectors, full-stack supply-chain coordination, safe harbors and a supply-chain security hub, and SI safety and resilience. As described in the source, it is a statement of intent: no binding commitments, funding levels, deadlines or enforcement mechanisms were announced.
